tools.name: build_swap_tx
tools.description: Turn a quoteId from get_quote into transaction data for the swap. Returns an UNSIGNED transaction: this server never holds keys, never signs and never broadcasts. The calling agent (or the user's wallet) signs and submits it. Quotes expire, so build shortly after quoting.

userAddress.description: Sender address the transaction is built for

tools.name: get_quote
tools.description: Race the BazaarSwap routing backend for cross-chain swap quotes (for example EVM assets into ADA) and return the best route plus every route found, sorted by net output. Read-only: quoting moves no funds. Amounts are in the source token's smallest unit. The returned quoteId feeds build_swap_tx. The race can take up to ~35 seconds. An EMPTY result usually means the backend was cold-starting, not that no route exists: wait ~30 seconds and retry once before reporting no route.

fromChain.description: Source chain id, e.g. "1" for Ethereum

toChain.description: Destination chain id, e.g. "CARDANO" for Cardano

toToken.description: Destination token address; native ADA on "CARDANO" is the zero address

amount.description: Amount to send, in the source token's smallest unit

userAddress.description: Sender address on the source chain

recipientAddress.description: Destination-chain recipient. Required for a swap into Cardano (the Cardano address that receives the ADA or token): without it the race finds no route. Same-format chains default to the sender.
